tasks.taskText: With GFM autolinking enabled, marked currently turns any text starting with "www." into a link regardless of letter case, so "Www.example.com" and "WWW.example.com" become links. Per the GFM spec a bare www autolink must start with lowercase "www." exactly; mixed- or upper-case variants must stay plain text. Scheme autolinks must remain case-insensitive for the scheme, so "(See hTtPS://example.com/fhqwhgads.)" must still produce a link with the trailing period excluded. Make "www." detection case-sensitive without changing how http://, https:// or ftp:// are detected, and keep email autolinks working. Source lives under src/ (TypeScript); the library is built with npm run build:esbuild before tests run.
